Plan.Status.Updated: Projection updated. Save changes to update the stored plan.
Plan.Status.Invalid: Check the period and plan settings.
Status.FirstCheck: Checking the connection for the first time...
Status.LoadingPortfolio: Loading the portfolio and checking service availability...
Status.NoPositions: Portfolio loaded; no positions to subscribe to.
Status.StreamChecking: Portfolio loaded; checking the market data stream.
Status.StreamActive: Portfolio refreshed; market data stream is active.
Status.TokenMissing: API token not found. Check the user-level BOND_ANALYTICS_TOKEN variable and restart the application.
Status.Certificate: Windows does not trust the API root certificate. Update Windows root certificates or install the official certificate from a trusted source.
Status.NoAccounts: The API token has no available brokerage account.
Status.StreamInterrupted: The market data stream was interrupted. Check your internet connection; the application will retry.
Status.Timeout: The API request timed out. Check your internet connection; the application will retry.
Status.Unauthenticated: The API rejected the token. Check that it is valid and has read permissions.
Status.PermissionDenied: The token does not have permission to read the portfolio.
Status.Unavailable: The API service is unavailable or there is no network connection.
Status.DeadlineExceeded: The API did not respond in time. Check your network; the application will retry.
Status.UnknownApi: API error ({0}). See the application log for details.
Status.Generic: Could not refresh API data. Check your internet connection and application log; the application will retry.
